title.zh: 中性代际累计状态更新

summary: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.

identity.relation: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.
identity.direction: explicit 1-D density profiles and scalar parameters -> convergence/accumulation result
identity.definition: Append one generation to the accumulated state: accumulates distribution, density, per-generation stacks, and the completed generation index.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim and reproduced bit for bit on the declared legal domain
identity.geometry: none; a zero-dimensional profile relation over 1-D density vectors
identity.boundary: finite nonnegative 1-D density arrays of one shape, positive truncate
assumptions: The saved formal operator is ported verbatim; no repair is claimed.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: The previous accumulation state (or None for first call).
inputs.dtype: mapping of arrays and an integer
inputs.constraints: When supplied, must contain generation_distributions, generation_density_m3, total_distribution, total_density_m3, completed_generation_index.

inputs.name: generation_density_m3
inputs.constraints: A finite nonnegative one-dimensional array aligned to the distribution spatial axis.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A mapping with total_distribution, total_density_m3, generation_distributions (stacked), generation_density_m3 (stacked), and completed_generation_index.
outputs.dtype: mapping of arrays and an integer
outputs.constraints: All arrays finite; total_distribution = sum of all generation distributions; completed_generation_index is the 0-based index of the last appended generation.

preconditions: Finite nonnegative aligned density profiles; positive truncate.
supported: Convergence stopping and accumulation state updates for H and H2 neutral transport generation loops.
excluded: Non-density convergence criteria; external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when density vectors are non-finite, have negative entries, shape mismatch, or truncate is nonpositive.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Not applicable; convergence/accumulation is a deterministic arithmetic step.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this relation reports convergence, it does not iterate.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.

example.description: Accumulate two generations and verify the totals.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import update_neutral_generation_accumulation
dist1 = np.ones((1, 1, 2))
dens1 = np.array([1.0, 2.0])
state1 = update_neutral_generation_accumulation(None, dist1, dens1)
assert state1['completed_generation_index'] == 0
dist2 = np.ones((1, 1, 2)) * 2
dens2 = np.array([2.0, 4.0])
state2 = update_neutral_generation_accumulation(state1, dist2, dens2)
assert state2['completed_generation_index'] == 1
np.testing.assert_array_equal(state2['total_distribution'], dist1 + dist2)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(state2['total_density_m3'], dens1 + dens2)
example.expected: After two calls, total_distribution is the sum of both distributions and completed_generation_index is 1.
